display.purpose: The hero name only, in solid foreground colour.

label.purpose: Geist Mono eyebrows and small technical asides.

readout.purpose: Metric value on featured cards, Geist Mono 600 at 1.25rem.

body-small.purpose: Sentences at reduced weight, 0.875rem: captions, bullets, supporting lines.

caption.purpose: Chips and tags, Geist Mono 0.75rem. The minimum size on the page.

shadows.name: chip-rest
shadows.purpose: The only resting shadow, on skill badges.

motion.name: spin-border
motion.purpose: Conic gradient border traversing a card on hover.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid signal-colored action, e.g. Contact or Resume.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action with a hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all .15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Skill Badge
components.description: Technology chip with an icon; fills with accent on hover.
components.css: .ds-skill-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; background: var(--background); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 80%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); cursor: default; transition: all .15s; } .ds-skill-badge:hover { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-foreground); border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 40%, transparent); }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: Frosted panel used for projects and experience; glow appears on hover.
components.css: .ds-glass-card { padding: 24px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--glass-bg); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); color: var(--card-foreground); backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.8); transition: box-shadow .3s; } .ds-glass-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 40px -10px var(--glow-primary); } .ds-glass-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-glass-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); line-height: 1.6; }

narrative.overview: A late-night engineering bench. The page sits on deep indigo-black, and the only light in the room comes from one cool cyan-blue signal, one still wash of the accent hue behind the hero, and frosted panels that read like instrument screens. It is quiet by default. Content, diagrams, and live demos lead, and the chrome stays out of their way.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first, cool-tinted neutrals (hue 270); no pure black or white.
One accent hue family (blue-cyan), with violet as a quiet secondary tint on dividers, the timeline line, badges and the hover border.
Frosted glass surfaces, flat at rest, with glow and the animated border appearing only on hover or state. No text gradients, tilt, glare or counting animations.
Geist for text, Geist Mono for small technical labels.
All color comes from OKLCH tokens in globals.css.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Cyan-blue is the only accent hue for interface meaning (interactive, current, focus). Violet is a tint on decoration only; if it ever marks something clickable or current, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: No hex or rgb in components. The .glow-bg radial in globals.css is a legacy exception, not precedent.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Machines Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is for labels and technical asides, never for paragraphs.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Touched Rule
rules.body: Glow and the animated gradient border show up on hover, focus, or active state. At rest, a card is a flat pane of glass.

rules.name: The Blur Must Compile Rule
rules.body: Glass is authored through Tailwind's backdrop-blur and backdrop-saturate utilities via @apply. A raw backdrop-filter declaration was silently dropped by the CSS pipeline, so do not rewrite it.

rules.name: The 12/14 Floor Rule
rules.body: Chips and mono labels are never below 12px; anything a person reads as a sentence is never below 14px. No literal sizes such as text-[10px].

dos: Do take every color from the OKLCH tokens in globals.css, in both themes.
Do keep surfaces flat at rest and let glow and gradient borders appear on hover or focus.
Do use Geist Mono only for short labels and technical asides.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion for every animation, and make content render fully without any reveal animation.
Do check contrast in dark and light mode whenever color changes.
donts: Don't add a second saturated accent hue, and don't use violet for anything interactive.
Don't hardcode hex, rgb, or Tailwind slate/gray utilities in components.
Don't hide content behind scroll-triggered reveals that leave blank space when they haven't fired.
Don't reintroduce Marquee, Typewriter, TextGenerate, or GridPattern without an explicit job for them.
Don't write a raw backdrop-filter; use the Tailwind @apply route.
